name: Wood County, OH
findings: Wood County has 465 nonprofit organizations. 223 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 180 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Wood County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
34% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Wood County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 146 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Wood County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 54% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Union organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 11 union organizations here list membership, compared with about 4 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do union organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 47% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
